text:
Subject: Charged AGAIN after cancellation - this is unacceptable
Body: I cancelled my subscription on the 3rd. I was charged again on the 5th.
This is the second time this has happened. If this is not refunded by tomorrow,
I am disputing the charge with my bank and leaving a public review.

criteria: low — general question, no time pressure
medium — issue needs resolving within a few days
high — customer is blocked or very frustrated
critical — customer threatening to leave or escalate

churn_risk.instructions: Is the customer at risk of churning (cancelling or leaving)?

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of this message?

contains_threat.instructions: Does the customer threaten a chargeback, legal action, or public review?
